messages:
Joan: Kicking off a 10% canary for embed-model-v2. I want to propose an automatic fallback and safe-rollback policy we can wire into the console and API.

Sam: Sounds good. Which failure signals are we protecting against? latency spikes, error rate, and capacity contention?

Joan: Yes. My proposal is a prioritized decision graph:
1) model_variant fallback -> attempt a compatible lower-cost variant (e.g., quant-v2-q4)
2) regional failover -> route the canary portion to a different region pool
3) capacity fallback -> redirect to reserved/dedicated capacity or shed low-priority traffic

Maria: From Product: need telemetry surfaced in the rollout timeline. Show which fallback fired, timestamp, delta traffic, and link to the rule that triggered it.

Kyle: UI idea: add micro-badges on the canary timeline ("model-fallback" / "region-failover") with a quick "view policy" link and buttons: [Accept fallback] [Revert]. Allow teams to toggle auto-apply vs manual.

Sam: API sketch (pseudo):

```
rollout_policy: {
  canary: {percent:10, duration:"30m"},
  thresholds: {error_rate_pct:5, p95_ms:800},
  fallbacks: [
    {type:"model_variant", target:"quant-v2-q4", trigger:"thresholds"},
    {type:"region", target:"us-west-2", trigger:"capacity"},
    {type:"capacity", target:"dedicated:reserved", trigger:"queue>50"}
  ],
  auto_apply: true
}
```

Anil: SRE concern: prevent flip-flopping. Add cooldowns and a max-frequency per-action. e.g., at most one auto-fallback per 15m per rollout, and backoff before retry.

Joan: Agreed. Also require a compatibility pre-check against the model catalog. If a variant is incompatible (tokenization/schema mismatch), skip to the next fallback and annotate telemetry as "incompatible-variant".

Maria: For A/B experiments, Variant B should be treated as an experiment bucket. If a fallback triggers, we should either fail the experiment (route B to baseline) or mark B as "degraded" and stop collection.

Kyle: UX: when auto-fallback runs show a toast: "Auto-fallback applied: quant-v2-q4 (reduced fidelity) — view details". Also a panel "Why" that shows evaluated rule and metric snapshot.

Sam: Logging/observability: every auto-action emits a structured event: reason, metric_snapshot, decision_path, triggered_at, action_id. Console should reference action_id for drilldown.

Joan: Ops tasks: 1) decision engine changes (compat checks, cooldowns, rate-limits) 2) schema + API changes 3) console annotations & toast 4) telemetry events + dashboard tile for "fallback actions". I'll file tickets and an RFC.

Anil: I'll draft safe defaults so experiments don't escalate to customer-impacting fallbacks. Also suggest an org-level opt-out flag for auto-fallback.

Maria: Legal/Product note: mark fallback-to-cheaper-models as "best-effort quality" so it isn't considered an SLA breach in reporting.

Sam: Edge-case: if fallback to a variant that changes response format, we must reject that action. Add a gate: variant_compat == true.

Joan: Also want a small DSL that advanced teams can use in the console to express custom triggers. Example:

```
when(error_rate_pct > 3 && p95_ms > 600, then: [model_variant:quant-v2-q4, cooldown:10m])
```

Sam: Keep the DSL optional. API-first for programmatic use, DSL for human editing.

Joan: If no objections I'll write the RFC tomorrow and include the simulation harness for rollout decisions.

deploy-bot: rollout created: canary 10% -> embed-model-v2 (policy: auto-fallback-enabled)

Kyle: :thumbsup:
